title: Building the Steam Controller
summary: Valve's short video on building the Steam Controller on a heavily automated assembly line, which the company designed itself. It shows the robotic manufacturing process and US final assembly.
why: HN cites it as a glimpse of in-house, highly automated hardware manufacturing and the scale of a lights-off factory.

quote.text: worth watching the Valve Steam Controller Factory video to appreciate the scale of these lights off factories
